description: This file defines an interface for an Orleans grain that manages asynchronous enumerable data streams, including methods for control operations and retrieving values.

classes.name: IObservableGrain
classes.description: An interface for a grain that supports asynchronous streaming of string and integer data, with control and error handling capabilities.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Signals that the grain has completed sending data.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Signals that the grain has encountered a failure.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Sends the next data item to the stream.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of string values.

methods.name: GetValuesWithError
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of integers with a possibility of error at a specified index.

methods.name: GetIncomingCalls
methods.description: Retrieves the list of incoming method calls with their interface and method names.

calls: GetValuesWithError(int errorIndex, bool waitAfterYield, string errorMessage, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
